kyc.title: KYC Verification Guide
kyc.uploadSuccess: ✅ Documents uploaded successfully! Your KYC status is now Pending.

idsAccepted.title: Which IDs are acceptable?
idsAccepted.option1: Passport, national ID card, driver’s license, or any government-issued ID.
idsAccepted.option2: ID must be valid and unexpired.
idsAccepted.option3: Must show profile photo and date of birth.
idsAccepted.option4: All information must be clear and readable.

idPhotos.title: How to properly take photos of your ID?
idPhotos.option2: ID must be original — no screenshots, copies, or photos of screens.
idPhotos.option3: All corners of the document must be visible.
idPhotos.option4: Both front and back must be uploaded (unless ID has one side only).

selfie.title: Selfie Holding ID Instructions
selfie.option2: ID must be facing camera clearly and fully visible.
selfie.option3: Your face must be unobstructed (no masks, glasses, hats, etc.).
selfie.option5: Ensure ID and face are clear and not blocked.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: This guide is provided by FlySky Network for informational purposes only. The information collected is used solely for identity verification. Crypto/digital asset investments involve risk. Consult your legal/tax/investment professional if needed.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: What happens after I upload my documents?
faq.a1: Our team will review them within 1–3 business days. You’ll be notified of approval or rejection.
faq.q2: Can I use my driver’s license?
faq.a2: Yes, as long as it’s government-issued and shows your photo and date of birth.
faq.q3: What if my ID has no back side?
faq.a3: If your ID (like a passport) has only one side, just upload the front only.
faq.a4: We accept images in JPG, PNG, or JPEG format.
faq.q5: What if my KYC was rejected?
faq.a5: You will receive a reason. You can re-upload corrected documents.

about.title: About Us
about.intro: FlySky Network is a next-generation digital economy platform that integrates mining, staking, gaming, and NFTs into one seamless experience. We are committed to building a vibrant ecosystem that enables users to earn, trade, and grow their assets in an entertaining environment.
about.vision: To become the most engaging and rewarding digital economy platform, empowering users around the world to thrive in the evolving digital landscape.
about.mission: We aim to bridge the gap between traditional finance and the digital world by offering accessible mining, fair staking, fun gaming, and a dynamic NFT marketplace.

features.mining: Start earning FSN tokens through our energy-efficient proof-of-activity model.
features.staking: Stake your digital tokens and watch your assets grow while supporting the network.
features.gaming: Enjoy exciting games that reward your skills with real digital assets.
features.nft: Trade unique NFTs and unlock exclusive items and collectibles within games.

whitepaper.title: Whitepaper
whitepaper.overview: A comprehensive document outlining our project's philosophy, technical architecture, and future plans.
whitepaper.intro: FlySky Network is designed to redefine the user-tech relationship by integrating multiple digital elements into one ecosystem.
whitepaper.tokenIntro: FSN is the cornerstone of the FlySky economy, used for mining, staking, purchases, and rewards.
whitepaper.phase: We follow a phased execution plan that includes pre-sale, public sale, and full launch stages.
whitepaper.mainSale: The main sale occurs in stages, ensuring fair allocation and complete transparency.
whitepaper.uses: The token is used for: mining, rewards, marketplace fees, governance, and character development within games.
whitepaper.gameIntro: Battle Legend is the first Survive-to-Earn game combining strategy, entertainment, and rewards.
whitepaper.gameDetails: The game offers vehicles, weapons, and a resource system within a fully integrated economy based on the BLT token.

features.vehicles: Various upgradeable and tradable vehicles as NFTs.
features.theft: A theft system allowing vehicles to be stolen or converted into spare parts.
features.maintenance: A periodic maintenance system affecting vehicle performance.
features.base: Building upgrades like the maintenance facility are tied to the main base level.
features.roles: A role system including warriors and traders within a dynamic economy.

whitepaper.conclusionDesc: FlySky Network represents the unified future of technology, economy, and entertainment. Join us now.
whitepaper.join: Be part of the digital revolution — Join FlySky Network now.
